fusions.name: Drawn Dose
fusions.desc: Draws out every affliction you have on the target: it deals 16 damage, with 60% more for each one drawn. 25% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Brackish Outflow
fusions.desc: Expels fouled water in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage and leaving everything in it [Poisoned] for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Filtered Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you, and you regain 12 health.

fusions.name: Passed Through
fusions.desc: As one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
